articles.title: India's GDP growth likely slowed to 7.6% in Q2FY27, India Ratings projects
articles.description: India's economy has experienced a growth of 7.6% year-on-year in the July-September quarter of FY27. This growth was primarily fueled by investment, even with challenges posed by El Nino and high oil prices. While private consumption slightly decreased to 6.8%, gross fixed capital formation rose significantly, suggesting strong investment activity. Future consumption may face pressures due to factors like tighter monetary conditions and El Nino impacts.

articles.title: Egypt prosecutors announce arrest of man over deadly truck disaster
articles.description: Egyptian prosecutors announced on Thursday the arrest of a man accused of causing a massive fire that erupted when a fuel tanker overturned on a packed highway in Cairo, killing 31 people. The prosecution said the man had "admitted" to speeding when his car collided with the tanker, "causing the steering wheel to slip from his hands and his car to veer off course". When the car hit the truck, one of its tyres exploded, causing it to overturn, the prosecution said. The fire erupted as a result of a petrol leak, it added.
